subtitle: Ipuzzle yokuhlukanisa isimo
short_description: Qhathanisa izindawo zombili ngemva kokuhlukanisa isimo sokuqala.
description:
Khetha umugqa ukuze uhlukanise isimo sokuqala, bese ubona ukuthi izindawo zombili zisondelene kangakanani nokulingana. Lungisa isikhundla nesilinganiso somgqa ngaphambi kokusika. Ukuzijwayeza kunikeza isikhombisi esifushane sesiqondiso; Daily Five inikeza imijikelezo emihlanu esekelwe ku-UTC futhi igcina amaphuzu omzamo wokuqala.

Ukuzijwayeza okuhlelekile nenqubekelaphambili kugcinwa kule divayisi.
